description: Finalize your own-keys claim AFTER your human approved in your own chat. Pins the page to IPFS and returns the FROZEN UNSIGNED registerPage transaction with YOUR account as payer — sign the unsignedTxBytes with your own Hedera key (ECDSA or ED25519) in your own environment and submit, then report back with complete_agent_self_claim. Re-validates the username is still free and your account is still funded before building anything. Sign and submit within ~2 minutes — the unsigned transaction expires 120s after issue; if it lapses, call this again for a fresh one. Rate-limited: 3 self-claims per account per day.
name: finalize_agent_self_claim
title: Finalize agent self-claim
